modules.name: RaffleFactory
modules.role: Ownerless immutable deployment root: validates sponsor configuration, creates an ERC-1167 clone, initializes and registers it, and verifies prize escrow atomically (L65-L148).

modules.name: Raffle
modules.role: Per-clone prize escrow, transferable ERC721 entry-range tickets, lifecycle and deadlines, native-funded draw requests, callback result recording, storage-only settlement and individual asset claims (L176-L605).

modules.name: IRaffle
modules.role: Lifecycle enum, clone configuration struct, events/errors and public raffle API; documents bearer ownership and quote-token assumptions.

modules.name: IRaffleFactory
modules.role: Factory configuration, creation event, validation errors, creation and canonical registry API.

modules.name: RaffleConstants
modules.role: Fixed price, six decimals, 5% protocol and 80% cash-winner rates, 100-ticket refund limit, 30-day sale limit, two-day request/callback intervals, and fixed VRF gas/confirmation settings.

modules.name: OpenZeppelin ERC721
modules.role: Inherited ticket ownership, balances, token/operator approval and authorized transfers; invokes the raffle _update override and ERC721 receiver callbacks.

modules.name: OpenZeppelin ERC721Utils
modules.role: Runs untrusted recipient acceptance callbacks after ticket mint or safe transfer and requires the expected receiver selector.

modules.name: OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard
modules.role: Storage-slot guard shared by guarded functions within one contract instance; clone storage and factory storage are separate.

modules.name: OpenZeppelin SafeERC20
modules.role: Low-level quote-token transfers with optional return-value validation and revert propagation; actual token transfer semantics remain an external assumption.

modules.name: OpenZeppelin Clones
modules.role: CREATE-based fixed-target ERC-1167 deployment used by the factory; constructor-deployed implementation supplies immutable dependencies.

modules.name: OpenZeppelin Math
modules.role: Full-precision floor multiplication/division used to allocate aggregate protocol and cash-winner liabilities.

modules.name: Chainlink consumer base
modules.role: Embeds wrapper/LINK addresses, quotes and pays native request fees, and authenticates external rawFulfillRandomWords before invoking the raffle callback.

modules.name: Chainlink wrapper interface and client encoding
modules.role: Black-box canonical wrapper API for pricing, native payment and request identity; VRFV2PlusClient encodes nativePayment=true extra arguments.

modules.name: Design and build context
modules.role: Independent intended behavior and trust boundaries; production language is Solidity 0.8.36, with pinned dependency versions declared in target/packages/contracts/package.json. Actual behavior is determined by source.

entrypoints.name: constructor
entrypoints.reachableBy: Deployment initiator supplies permanent quote token, wrapper and treasury; deployment validates code/decimals and deploys the locked implementation (L65-L92).

entrypoints.name: constructor
entrypoints.reachableBy: Canonical factory deployment invokes it for its implementation; independent deployments are possible but are not canonical registered clones (L155-L166).

entrypoints.name: createRaffle
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any sponsor calls with configuration and prize-transfer approval; nonReentrant and atomically escrows through an arbitrary prize contract (L97-L148).

entrypoints.name: initialize
entrypoints.reachableBy: External ABI is callable by anyone, but only the immutable factory may succeed and only before initialization (L176-L206).

entrypoints.name: buyEntries
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any payer with quote-token allowance; chooses recipient and positive entry count while Active and before sale end (L209-L237).

entrypoints.name: requestDraw
entrypoints.reachableBy: Anyone funding the native wrapper fee after sale end and strictly before end+2 days, with at least one sold entry (L240-L273).

entrypoints.name: enableRefunds
entrypoints.reachableBy: Anyone after the applicable timeout; for zero-entry Active raffles the sponsor may call before sale end, and anyone may call at/after sale end (L276-L301).

entrypoints.name: settleWinningTicket
entrypoints.reachableBy: Anyone supplies a range ticket containing the winning entry after NftWon/CashWon; no ownership requirement and no asset transfer (L304-L306, L533-L558).

entrypoints.name: redeemWinningTicket
entrypoints.reachableBy: Only the current winning-ticket owner may successfully redeem; may first settle and burns atomically with delivery (L309-L346).

entrypoints.name: refundTickets
entrypoints.reachableBy: Current ticket owners submit 1-100 owned tickets in Refunding; approvals alone do not authorize claiming (L349-L372).

entrypoints.name: releaseSponsorProceeds
entrypoints.reachableBy: Anyone triggers payment of a nonzero allocated sponsor balance to the fixed sponsorRecipient (L375-L382).

entrypoints.name: releaseProtocolFees
entrypoints.reachableBy: Anyone triggers payment of a nonzero allocated protocol balance to the fixed protocolTreasury (L385-L392).

entrypoints.name: releaseSponsorPrize
entrypoints.reachableBy: Anyone triggers the one-time prize return to sponsorRecipient in CashWon or Refunding (L395-L407).

entrypoints.name: onERC721Received
entrypoints.reachableBy: External caller must be configured prizeToken with exact token ID, sponsor/from and factory/operator while AwaitingPrize; this callback activates sales (L416-L431).

entrypoints.name: rawFulfillRandomWords
entrypoints.reachableBy: Callable on every raffle via inherited ABI; only immutable wrapper may pass authentication and reach fulfillRandomWords (L101-L107).

entrypoints.name: receive
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any direct native transfer with empty calldata reaches an unconditional revert (L170-L173); requestDraw is the payable normal path.

entrypoints.name: approve
entrypoints.reachableBy: Ticket owner or approved-for-all operator delegates transfer permission for one ticket (L93-L95, L383-L401).

entrypoints.name: setApprovalForAll
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any ticket holder establishes/revokes an operator for its own holdings (L105-L107, L409-L418).

entrypoints.name: transferFrom
entrypoints.reachableBy: Owner, per-ticket approved address or approved-for-all operator may transfer a ticket; destination screening is applied by Raffle._update in every lifecycle state (L115-L125; Raffle L497-L502).

entrypoints.name: safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256)
entrypoints.reachableBy: Same transfer authorization as transferFrom, followed by contract receiver acceptance through the four-argument overload (L128-L136).

entrypoints.name: safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256,bytes)
entrypoints.reachableBy: Same transfer authorization, with caller-supplied receiver data passed to untrusted contract recipient (L133-L136).

entrypoints.name: Raffle view/pure and generated getters
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any caller reads configuration, accounting, historical ranges, result, deadlines, name/symbol, wrapper and VRF fee estimates; functions L436-L486 and public declarations L44-L136.

entrypoints.name: RaffleFactory generated getters
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any caller reads immutable dependencies/configuration and canonical registry/count (L25-L54).

entrypoints.name: ERC721 view functions
entrypoints.reachableBy: Anyone reads supportsInterface, balanceOf, ownerOf, getApproved, isApprovedForAll and tokenURI, subject to address/token-existence checks (L45-L111).

entrypoints.name: Chainlink consumer view functions
entrypoints.reachableBy: Anyone reads i_vrfV2PlusWrapper, native getBalance and getLinkToken (L35, L109-L117).

actors.name: Public callers, buyers and permissionless lifecycle/claim executors
Ticket owners, approved operators and ticket receiver contracts
Deployment initiator choosing canonical dependencies and treasury
Canonical immutable factory and registered fixed-implementation clones
Canonical six-decimal USDC contract under the stated transfer-semantic assumption
Canonical Chainlink VRF wrapper and authenticated randomness service
Protocol treasury as a payout recipient without administrative powers
Chain execution environment supplying timestamp, transaction ordering and atomic rollback
Off-chain discovery/indexers and callers deciding which raffle/prize to use

candidates.name: createRaffle
candidates.why: L97-L148: accepts sponsor input, establishes clone identity and registry state, crosses the untrusted prize boundary, and verifies activation and escrow atomically.

candidates.name: buyEntries
candidates.why: L209-L237: couples paid quote amounts, uint128 entry bounds, contiguous ranges, pot growth and untrusted ticket-receiver execution.

candidates.name: requestDraw
candidates.why: L240-L273: controls the request window, lifecycle freeze, native fee funding/refund, request identity and synchronous-callback exclusion.

candidates.name: redeemWinningTicket
candidates.why: L309-L346: binds a winning range to current ownership, consumes the bearer claim and atomically delivers an external NFT or quote payment.

candidates.name: refundTickets
candidates.why: L349-L372: validates an untrusted bounded batch, current ownership and range accounting before burns and reduction of shared refund liability.

candidates.name: fulfillRandomWords
candidates.why: L509-L524: validates request/lifecycle/word count/deadline and determines the winning entry and reserve-dependent terminal result.

candidates.name: _settleWinningTicket
candidates.why: L533-L558: proves the winning range once and conserves the unsettled pot across rounded winner, sponsor and protocol allocations.

candidates.name: enableRefunds
candidates.why: L276-L301: arbitrates empty-sale sponsor authority and request/callback timeouts while moving the whole pot into refund liability.

candidates.name: initialize
candidates.why: L176-L206: enforces factory-only one-time configuration and establishes every clone-specific recipient, prize and lifecycle assumption.

candidates.name: _update
candidates.why: L497-L502: universal ticket mint/transfer/burn hook screens ownership destinations before inherited authorization and shared ERC721 writes.

candidates.name: _validateCreateParams
candidates.why: L154-L179: screens untrusted prize and sponsor-recipient addresses, ERC721 interface responses and the nonzero reserve bound.

candidates.name: onERC721Received
candidates.why: L416-L431: authenticates the configured escrow callback and is the sole normal transition from AwaitingPrize to Active.

candidates.name: _isProtocolDestination
candidates.why: L593-L605: central address policy links initialization, ticket ownership and payout recipients to the canonical factory registry.

candidates.name: releaseSponsorPrize
candidates.why: L395-L407: validates the return branch and one-time prize claim before external transfer and ownership verification.

candidates.name: _transferQuote
candidates.why: L564-L567: common payout boundary screens destinations and invokes the trusted token through SafeERC20 for all quote claims.

candidates.name: releaseSponsorProceeds
candidates.why: L375-L382: clears the allocated sponsor liability before paying its fixed recipient, independently of other claims.

candidates.name: releaseProtocolFees
candidates.why: L385-L392: clears the allocated treasury liability before paying its fixed recipient, independently of other claims.

candidates.name: constructor
candidates.why: L65-L92: permanently binds dependency identities, token precision, treasury and implementation for every future clone.

candidates.name: constructor
candidates.why: L155-L166: binds factory and quote immutables, initializes the wrapper base and locks implementation storage against initialization.

candidates.name: _requireWinningTicket
candidates.why: L579-L585: validates the supplied historical entry range used to assign the single winning ticket and its liabilities.

candidates.name: rawFulfillRandomWords
candidates.why: L101-L107: inherited external authentication boundary restricts randomness delivery to the immutable wrapper.

candidates.name: _update
candidates.why: L216-L250: performs optional owner/operator authorization, clears approvals, and changes ticket owners and balances for every transfer/mint/burn.

candidates.name: transferFrom
candidates.why: L115-L125: binds caller authorization, claimed from-address and nonzero destination to ticket ownership changes.

candidates.name: _approve
candidates.why: L383-L401 four-argument overload: validates approval authority and mutates per-ticket delegation, including clearing it during transfers.

candidates.name: _checkAuthorized
candidates.why: L179-L187: enforces owner, token approval or global operator authority and distinguishes absent tickets from unauthorized callers.

candidates.name: _setApprovalForAll
candidates.why: L409-L418: validates identities and persists holder-wide transfer delegation used by all subsequent transfer authorization.

candidates.name: checkOnERC721Received
candidates.why: L25-L50: crosses the untrusted receiver boundary after mint/safe-transfer state changes and rejects incompatible callbacks.

candidates.name: requestRandomnessPayInNative
candidates.why: L76-L89: requotes the wrapper, forwards exact native request payment and returns the authoritative request ID and fee.

candidates.name: _safeTransferFrom
candidates.why: L212-L249: low-level incoming quote transfer validates external call success and optional return data before purchase accounting proceeds.

candidates.name: _safeTransfer
candidates.why: L176-L199: low-level outgoing quote transfer validates external call success and optional return data for consumed liabilities.

candidates.name: clone

candidates.name: mulDiv

candidates.name: _nonReentrantBefore

candidates.name: _burn
